task.title: Modification required — Blocked or archived claim

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if there is a registration number for modifying the claimant’s report:

ul.li: If there is a registration number, go to step 2.

If there is no registration number, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Determine the information that must be modified:

ul.li: If only earnings must be modified, go to step 3.
If earnings and an FWW code must be modified for a week of regular benefits, go to step 3.
For any other change, go to step 11.

step.cmd: Determine the blocked claim’s status by reviewing the Blocked Status column under the Blocked tab:

ul.li: If 1 - Updateable is displayed , go to step 4.
If 2 - Not blocked is displayed, return to Active or terminated claim . Active or terminated claim
If any other status is displayed, go to step 11.

step.cmd: Review the Blocked Action Pending column:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, go to step 5.
If all rows are blank, go to step 7.

step.cmd: In NWS, move the WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “waiting for an updateable status in BCS.”
Bring forward date: Enter [the next business day].

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, in FTS, review the Blocked Action Pending column under the Blocked tab:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, return to step 5.
If all rows are blank, go to step 7.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the BPC you want to update from the Blocked Status column. When the Blocked Claim screen opens, complete the following fields:

ul.li: Action required: Select Claim update .
Agreed deduction: Select (100%) Blocked claim system default .
Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
C - Yes to clear the registration number
D - No to leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions
Select Update .

step.cmd: Under the Allocation “A” tab, in the Amended Earnings column, enter the amended earnings as follows:

ul.li:
Select the week that requires a change. Repeat for every week that requires a change.
Amended earnings: Enter the new amount of earnings (if a change is needed).
FWW: If a change is needed, select the new FWW code.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select the appropriate option:
A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
B - Non-fraud - Availability, capability .
Message: Select the appropriate option:
6 - Earnings other than declared .
22 - An overpayment resulted because you were not available .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Under the Pending Transactions tab, review the transaction:

ul.li: If the transaction shown is incorrect, go to step 10.
If the transaction shown is correct, select Close and go to step 14.

step.cmd: Delete the incorrect transaction as follows:

ul.li: Delete: Check the box next to the incorrect transaction.
Select Update .
Select Close .
Return to step 8.

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to automatically generate an Operation Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
Select Memo (MPS) .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the claim requiring the claimant’s report modification.

If the amended report will create an OP, do the following:
Work item: Select 91 - Overpayment .
Work type: Select 2 - Non-misrepresentation .

If the amended report will create UP, do the following:
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 33 - Blocked claim requiring payment .
Earnings to be allocated: If required, enter the new weeks and amounts information.
Remarks Line 1: If required, type “ALLOC: [allocation information]; FWW: [full work week information, if changes are required].”
Remarks Line 2: If required, enter the new availability and training information.
Remarks Line 4: Enter your first name and last name.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .

Infraction: Select the appropriate option:
A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
B - Non-fraud - Availability, capability .

Message: Select the appropriate option:
6 - Earnings other than declared .
22 - An overpayment resulted because you were not available .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction to transfer the registration number to the IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In NWS, determine if there is a WI for modifying the claimant’s report:

ul.li: If yes, complete the WI.
If no, return to the initial task.
